{{Top|leg}}
A '''portable beacon''', also known as a '''landing beacon''', was a a one meter-long device that transmitted signals that could be received only by [[Sensor/Legends|sensors]]. It was able to transmit a signal to a range of 10,000 kilometers from a [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] surface. It usually broadcast a simple signal to mark a landing zone, but could be reprogrammed with a [[Datapad/Legends|datapad]] to broadcast a warning or distress signal.

It had a pointed end that could be used to embed it in the ground, but it also came with a tripod that allowed it to be mounted on a hard flat surface.
